title: 813. Bus Routes

examples.explanation: Ride the first bus to stop 7, then change to the second bus to reach 6.
No chain of shared stops connects 15 to 12.
Start and destination coincide, so no bus is needed.

hints: Index every stop to the list of buses serving it, turning transfers into graph edges.
Breadth-first search over buses (not stops) starting from all buses at the source; the first time a bus reaches the target its depth is the answer.
